Office of International Services | Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist

content.text:
**wakehealth.edu** is the website for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, an academic medical center and health system based in **Winston-Salem, North Carolina**. It appears to be a legitimate `.edu` domain associated with Wake Forest University / Wake Forest Baptist. ([scam-detector.com](https://www.scam-detector.com/validator/wakehealth-edu-review/?utm_source=openai))

If you’re trying to do something specific, common pages include:

- **Patient care / locations / doctors:** Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist
- **Volunteer services:** uses contact email `voldept@wakehealth.edu` on their site ([wakehealth.edu](https://www.wakehealth.edu/about-us/volunteer-services/adult-volunteers?utm_source=openai))
- **Careers / international services:** listed under Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist careers pages ([wakehealth.edu](https://www.wakehealth.edu/about-us/careers/international-services?utm_source=openai))
- **Wake Forest School of Medicine:** often uses `school.wakehealth.edu`

If you received an email or link from `wakehealth.edu`, it is likely tied to Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist, but still check that the full URL is exactly under `wakehealth.edu` and not a lookalike domain.
